scope: Sina, T2: demand forecasting and inventory decisions

inventory_setup.initial_stock: ceiling of first protection forecast, no pipeline
inventory_setup.tail: extend the last available forecast from the same origin

history_repair: 4 flagged sales observations replaced by mean of preceding four weeks; flagged test observations excluded from forecast scores

decomposition.name: Plush Bear
decomposition.method: classical additive: centred 52-week moving average; median weekly season over the three years

ses_alpha.fitted_on: weeks up to the last backtest origin (t < 152)
